description: A librarian must keep track of interlibrary loan requests across request, shipment, arrival, pickup, return, and overdue stages when each request can stall in a different place.

user_profile.persona: 35-year-old resource-sharing librarian handling many small requests in parallel
user_profile.context: Patrons ask for updates, but the status trail is distributed across messages, labels, and partner library systems
user_profile.communication_style: Status-oriented and service-focused, wants each request made easy to locate in the pipeline

The lending library for request ILL-2024-781 is the Oak Valley Public Library.
The primary contact for ILL at Oak Valley Public Library is David Lee, reachable at d.lee@oakvalleylib.org.
Crestmont University Library uses the NRE (National Request Exchange) system for all academic loan requests.
Crestmont University Library's phone number for their ILL department is 555-821-4091.
The tracking number for 'The Gilded Compass' (ILL-2024-781) is LLC-881-59B-234 via LibraryLogistics Couriers.
The shipment for 'Echoes of the Void' (ILL-2024-792) from Crestmont University Library has not yet been dispatched as of October 25, 2024.
LibraryLogistics Couriers' online tracking portal is located at https://track.librarylogistics.net.
The status of 'The Gilded Compass' (ILL-2024-781) was updated to 'Arrived - Awaiting Pickup' on October 24, 2024, at 11:15 AM.
The book 'Culinary Cartography' (ILL-2024-765) was due back to Maplewood City Library on October 18, 2024.
A request for the article 'Quantum Entanglement in Mycology' (ILL-2024-795) was filled electronically; a PDF was sent to the patron on October 23, 2024.
The physical copy of 'The Gilded Compass' is currently located on Shelf B-3 of the ILL Holding Shelf.
The primary ILL management software is LibriLink, accessible at https://maplewood.librilink.com.
The librarian's username for LibriLink is 'sjenkins' and her designated workstation is ILL-DESK-02.
The state-wide catalog search and request portal is StateShare Connect, with the URL: https://search.stateshareconnect.gov.
Patron records and local holdings are managed in the Horizon ILS system.
Automated patron notifications for ILL items are sent from the email address noreply@maplewood-libnotify.org.
The barcode scanner used to check in ILL items is a Zebra DS2208, located at workstation ILL-DESK-02.
All incoming ILL items must be placed on the designated 'ILL Holding Shelf' behind the main circulation desk, in Section B.
A bright yellow paper band must be wrapped around any ILL item that is currently in transit between libraries.
When an item arrives, its status must be updated in LibriLink within 1 hour of being unpacked from the courier bin.
Overdue notices for ILL items are automatically generated by LibriLink on the 3rd, 7th, and 15th day past the due date.
The fee for a lost ILL item is the replacement cost set by the lending library, plus a $15.00 processing fee from Maplewood City Library.
All returned ILL items must be packed in a gray, padded reusable envelope for shipment back to the lending library.
The dedicated Slack channel for communication with partner libraries in the metro area is #metro-ill-connect.
To request a renewal for an item, the librarian must send an email to the lending library's ILL contact at least 5 business days before the due date.
Patron Alex Chen called for a status update on ILL-2024-781 on October 25, 2024, at 2:30 PM.
The status 'Stalled - Contact Lender' is used in LibriLink when a request has not been updated by the partner library in over 10 days.
